config_a.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_quadrature8_v1
config_a.scope: Prospective full-cycle integration-sensitivity control after P2 residual verification. Compare against completed coarse P2/GAMG/1.25ms/degree6 from rest. Only source volume/facet quadrature degree changes to8; same geometry, displacement space, passive law, loading, solver and physical acceptance criteria. Nonpolynomial HGO stress requires an integration check independent of mesh/timestep sensitivity. Apply the same declared1% space-time displacement sensitivity threshold. This is a one-case numerical control, not continuum truth or a neural model-selection result.
